target_customer: Fintechs, payment companies, crypto and stablecoin platforms and marketplaces that must verify businesses and individuals
problem: Verifying businesses and people across many countries meant slow manual checks across fragmented registries and data sources.
business_model: Usage-based API plus platform subscription for KYB, KYC and AML
product_category: KYB, KYC and AML compliance platform

founders.name: Chaitanya Sarda
founders.background_notes: Led spam protection and Caller ID at Google per YC page.

founders.name: Rushabh Shah
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers or education.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating hundreds of government registries and data vendors behind one API is integration heavy; AI review agents came later.

defensibility.rationale: Registry coverage across 200+ countries and compliance certifications take time, but established KYB and identity vendors already sold overlapping products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large identity vendors kept expanding KYB; no incumbent bought AiPrise as of the sources found.

market_need_then: Fintech and crypto firms faced KYB and AML obligations across borders; sources opened for this record are current, so dated 2022 demand evidence was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Compliance infrastructure positioning, 'AI agents, global KYB and KYC in one API'

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press or community found; the name begins with AI which may date it, and capital P in the middle invites misspelling.

outcome_analysis: AiPrise grew from the YC Summer 2022 batch into a compliance platform with 150+ customers and about 40 to 65 staff, and announced a 12.5M Series A led by Headline in October 2025. Earlier funding is unclear beyond the YC deal. The crowded KYB market is the main risk; no exit or distress was found.
notes: Series A confirmed by multiple outlets. A 60M valuation appears only in Salestools and is not recorded. Prospeo lists a 2M round in 2022-10 with unknown type; single aggregator so not recorded. Total raised conflicts (14.5M to 15M). Headquarters reported as San Jose, San Francisco and Santa Clara. Education for both founders not listed. No dated 2022 competitor sources found. Name origin and logo not found.
